title.rendered: So This Happened (EP 405) reviews: VDM protest renews focus on abducted pupils

content.rendered:
Social media activist VeryDarkMan drew national attention to the plight of abducted pupils and teachers in Oyo State after leading a protest demanding urgent action to secure their release.

The demonstration, which later led to a meeting with Seyi Makinde, has renewed public conversations about insecurity, government response efforts, and the urgency of rescuing victims who have spent weeks in captivity.
